metadata.title: Tickett.com — Tickets for the best events
metadata.description: Buy tickets for concerts, parties, theatre, conferences and more in Portugal and across Europe. Secure checkout and tickets delivered by email.

footer.tagline: Fast, Safe and Easy — tickets since 2012

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.error: We couldn't subscribe you. Please try again.

featuredGrid.banner: <accent>Hundreds</accent> of events all over the world.

bilhetes.title: Official Tickets
bilhetes.description: We work directly with promoters and venues to guarantee 100% official tickets.

whatsapp.title: Get it on WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Digital ticket sent straight to your WhatsApp. Faster, simpler and safer.

mapa.title: All Over the World
mapa.description: The largest selection of concerts and events from all over the world in one place.

gestao360.title: 360º Management
gestao360.description: Centralise sales, access control, communication and financial management on a single platform, designed to simplify every stage of organising your events.

websites.title: Custom Websites
websites.description: We build exclusive websites for promoters and artists, fully aligned with each brand's identity. Every project is developed to deliver an intuitive experience, strengthen your digital presence and drive sales.

marketing.title: Marketing & Performance
marketing.description: We develop and run marketing strategies with email, WhatsApp and digital advertising campaigns, increasing your event's visibility and boosting ticket sales.

acessos.title: Access Control
acessos.description: Ensure fast, secure entry with Tickett.com's access control technology. Monitor capacity in real time, validate tickets instantly and reduce the risk of fraud.

equipas.title: Operations Teams
equipas.description: We provide specialist teams to reinforce your event's operation, covering box office, access control, sales, merchandising, audience assistance and technical support.

integracoes.title: Technology Integrations
integracoes.description: The Tickett.com platform integrates with a wide range of equipment and systems, adapting to the needs of each project to guarantee an efficient, uninterrupted operation.

merchandising.title: Merchandising
merchandising.description: Sell merchandise, exclusive products and add-on experiences through Tickett.com's sales channels, with centralised management of sales, stock and operations in real time.

suporte.title: Specialist Support
suporte.description: Our team supports promoters and partners before, during and after every event, providing technical and operational assistance, remote or on-site, to guarantee a continuous, uninterrupted operation.

whatsappDemo.instructions: Show the QR code at the door. Enjoy the show! 🎶

alertas.title: Never miss a concert again.
alertas.description: Get an email when your favourite artist announces a show.

promotor.title: Sell your event with Tickett.com
promotor.description: Everything you need to sell out venues: online ticketing, check-in, payments and dedicated support.
